I agree with these verdicts. The 'cheek pouches' checkpoint is visually supported by the broad head shape, even if the internal anatomy isn't visible. The Router was not too lenient; the visible anatomy conforms well to the class definition.
artifact_review: The Router identified paw fusion (severity 1.5) and object distortion (severity 2.0). The animal_pose_auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk (41% low-confidence keypoints), specifically in the hind limbs and face/ears. While the hind limbs are occluded (explaining some low confidence), the low confidence in the ears (keypoints 3 & 4) combined with the visual ambiguity of the paw digits suggests the Router's severity rating for the paws might be conservative. The fusion of digits into the white object is a classic AI generation failure mode. I will upgrade the severity of the paw anomaly to reflect the structural uncertainty confirmed by the pose auditor. The background pattern shows no obvious tiling artifacts upon close inspection.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirms the class (Hamster, logit 8.27 vs 2.75 for Guinea Pig). All testable checkpoints (Head, Face, Body, Fur) are met with high fidelity. The image is a strong representation of the target class despite the occlusion of rear anatomy.
